$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Claude Code resolves relative paths from the directory containing this file, so this works on Windows + Linux + macOS without edits.

domains-harness.$comment: Wraps the @domains/harness CLI as native MCP tools (ask, lookup, playbook, concept, related, cite, stats, capture). Claude calls these directly instead of shelling out to `! pnpm harness ask`. Source: ./packages/harness-mcp/src/index.ts

motherduck.$comment: Direct DuckDB query access — useful for ad-hoc SQL against the corpus when the harness commands don't cover what you need.
